answer_1.quote: MODULARQA, a modular system that explains its reasoning in natural language, by decomposing complex questions into those answerable by two sub-models: a neural factoid single-span QA model and a symbolic calculator.
answer_1.outputs: sub-questions and answers in natural language

answer_2.quote: MODULARQA scores only 3.7% F1 lower than NumNet+V2 ... MODULARQA even outperforms this blackbox model by 2% F1 in a limited data setting and demonstrates higher (+7% F1) robustness.

answer_4.quote: We asked crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk to annotate them along three dimensions: (1) given the two explanations, which system's answer do they trust more; (2) which system's explanation do they understand better; and (3) which system's explanation do they generally prefer.
answer_4.guideline: crowdworkers were asked to compare explanations along three dimensions: trust in the answer, understandability of the explanation, and overall preference.
